The '''MA-6 Frontline Droid''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used as security forces by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Virtually identical to the [[MA-9 Frontline Droid]], the MA-6 carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in combat, and a number of them were part of the security forces of [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The MA-6 Frontline Droid appears a type of enemy in the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access.<ref name="TOR" />
